tracker_controls.url_query_parameters: stripped from every Plausible request before transmission

privacy_boundary.notes: Campaign values are accepted only from the finite allowlists in this file and are retained in sessionStorage. The Plausible request transform strips the full query string before every request, including pageviews and custom events; allowlisted campaign values travel only as enumerated custom properties. Automatic form-submission tracking is disabled. No visitor identifier is created. Duplicate protection suppresses the same logical event key within one page lifecycle.

Qualifier Start.purpose: Measure whether the founder-first questions are started.
Qualifier Start.trigger: First answer change in the five-question homepage qualifier.
Qualifier Start.denominator: Unique homepage views in the same exact reporting window.

Qualifier Complete.purpose: Measure completion of the five-question qualifier.
Qualifier Complete.trigger: A complete valid qualifier submission renders a result.
Qualifier Complete.denominator: Qualifier Start events in the same exact reporting window.

Assessment Start.purpose: Measure entry into the fuller browser assessment.
Assessment Start.trigger: The visitor explicitly starts the assessment flow.
Assessment Start.denominator: Assessment-page views in the same exact reporting window.

Assessment Complete.purpose: Measure whether the fuller assessment reaches a rendered result.
Assessment Complete.trigger: A result is rendered after the visitor requests it.
Assessment Complete.denominator: Assessment Start events in the same exact reporting window.

Scanner Start.purpose: Measure explicit entry into the local browser scanner.
Scanner Start.trigger: The visitor opens the browser scanner.
Scanner Start.denominator: Assessment-page views in the same exact reporting window.

Scanner Complete.purpose: Measure successful browser-scan completion without reporting what was found.
Scanner Complete.trigger: The in-browser scanner renders a result without throwing.
Scanner Complete.denominator: Scanner Start events in the same exact reporting window.

Scanner Error.purpose: Measure browser-scan reliability without transmitting code or exception text.
Scanner Error.trigger: The in-browser scanner catches an exception and shows its recovery state.
Scanner Error.denominator: Scanner Start events in the same exact reporting window.

Install Command Copy.purpose: Measure intent to continue from browser results into the local CLI.
Install Command Copy.trigger: A visitor copies an installation or results CLI command.
Install Command Copy.denominator: Relevant result or installation-section views in the same window.
Install Command Copy.implementation: site/assess locale pages and install controls via RegulaAnalytics.track

GitHub Action Click.trigger: A labelled GitHub Action integration link is activated.
GitHub Action Click.denominator: Views of pages containing the labelled integration link.

MCP Click.trigger: A labelled MCP integration link is activated.
MCP Click.denominator: Views of pages containing the labelled integration link.

PyPI Click.trigger: A link to the regula-ai PyPI project is activated.
PyPI Click.denominator: Views of pages containing a PyPI link.

GitHub Click.trigger: A link to the Regula GitHub repository is activated.
GitHub Click.denominator: Views of pages containing a repository link.

Sample Report View.purpose: Measure whether visitors inspect a reproducible example output.
Sample Report View.trigger: A labelled sample report or executive-summary link is activated.
Sample Report View.denominator: Sample-report landing-page views in the same exact window.

Pricing View.purpose: Measure navigation to the truthful service-boundary page.
Pricing View.trigger: The pricing page completes DOM loading.
Pricing View.denominator: Qualified upstream continuation events in the same exact window.

Pricing FAQ Open.purpose: Identify which published service-boundary question is opened.
Pricing FAQ Open.trigger: A pricing FAQ disclosure changes to open.
Pricing FAQ Open.denominator: Pricing-page views in the same exact window.

Contact Intent.purpose: Measure an explicit move toward direct email without recording an address or message.
Contact Intent.trigger: A labelled consulting, organisation, or support mailto link is activated.
Contact Intent.denominator: Pricing or result-route views in the same exact window.

Enquiry Prepared.purpose: Measure completion of the future local-only enquiry-preparation flow.
Enquiry Prepared.trigger: A visitor explicitly generates a local enquiry summary.
Enquiry Prepared.denominator: Local enquiry-preparation starts in the same exact window.
Enquiry Prepared.implementation: Reserved; must not fire before the local-only flow exists.

Documentation Search.purpose: Measure use of a future first-party documentation search without recording query text.
Documentation Search.trigger: A first-party documentation search is submitted.
Documentation Search.denominator: Documentation search-form views in the same exact window.
Documentation Search.implementation: Reserved; must not fire before first-party documentation search exists.
